Back to GasBack

Design & licenses

GasBack's interface adapts the public login-page visual direction of Lovable's Expense It template: black canvas, green light, oversized type and a translucent form. The GasBack application, proof flow and contracts were developed for this hackathon. No Expense It backend, account system or private source code is included.

The background uses React Bits DarkVeil by David Haz, adapted for this application. MIT + Commons Clause license. Shader parameters are our visual adaptation, not asserted original template settings.
